No new endpoint, authorization surface, or trust boundary. Treat the issue-supplied run number as literal fixture content; do not execute or interpolate it into a command.

## Risks and edge cases

- Avoid adding a duplicate line if it is already present when implementation runs.

## Testing considerations
Verify the four lines in order, the preserved lines byte-for-byte, and that `git diff --name-only` lists only `tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt`.
